name: starting architecture
last_analysis: No scores are visible, so I can only reason from priors and from which trials ran cleanly. All 9 trials trained without errors. Two ideas recur. On the network side, a per-layer head lines each brick's landing layer up with the missing target cells. Giving it the layers below and above makes support and overhangs local features, which suits a game where bricks drop and order matters. On the recipe side, fewer PPO epochs give more fresh designs under a fixed compute budget. Since 2-seed noise is large, this last round should combine the most plausible ideas instead of testing new ones. I propose: (1) the richest layer head (r3c1) with 1 PPO epoch, giving about 1.6 times its sample count; (2) the starting network with 1 epoch, a clean test of the sample-count idea at about 425k steps; (3) the light layer head (r3c2) plus the adjacent-layer inputs, keeping 1 epoch. Each has one main change from a trial that already ran.
